# FFmpeg master

> Documentation generated from the latest `master` branch commit of [FFmpeg/FFmpeg](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg) and pinned to immutable source commit `639ee849526cfe61ceb312776335c245b98bd9d4`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for FFmpeg master.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Source ref, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- FFmpeg tracks master because its GitHub mirror does not publish GitHub releases.
- Primary Texinfo manuals and their checked-in includes are converted without executing Make, Texinfo, or FFmpeg binaries.
- Build-generated configuration sections, API Doxygen output, and duplicate Texinfo fragments are omitted.

## Development reference

- [FFmpeg README](pages/README.md): FFmpeg is a collection of libraries and tools to process multimedia content such as audio, video, subtitles and related metadata. (1798 bytes)
- [Installing FFmpeg](pages/INSTALL.md): configure can be launched from a directory different from the FFmpeg sources to build the objects out of tree. To do this, use an absolute path when launching configure, e.g. /ffmpegdir/ffmpeg/configure. (1114 bytes)
- [Note to Github users](pages/CONTRIBUTING.md): Patches should be submitted to Forgejo or the ffmpeg-devel mailing list using git format-patch or git send-email. Github pull requests should be avoided because they are not part of our review process and will be ignore… (429 bytes)
- [Build System.Txt](pages/doc/build_system.md): FFmpeg currently uses a custom build system, this text attempts to document some of its obscure features and options. (1788 bytes)
- [Filter design](pages/doc/filter_design.md): This document explains guidelines that should be observed (or ignored with good reason) when writing filters for libavfilter. (10689 bytes)
- [FFmpeg Infrastructure:](pages/doc/infra.md): Trademark: (5252 bytes)
- [FFmpeg's bug/feature request tracker manual](pages/doc/issue_tracker.md): FFmpeg uses Trac for tracking issues, new issues and changes to existing issues can be done through a web interface. (5844 bytes)
- [FFmpeg multithreading methods](pages/doc/multithreading.md): FFmpeg provides two methods for multithreading codecs. (2611 bytes)
- [optimization Tips (for libavcodec):](pages/doc/optimization.md): If you plan to do non-x86 architecture specific optimizations (SIMD normally), then take a look in the x86/ directory, as most important functions are already optimized for x86. (10347 bytes)
- [Rate Distortion.Txt](pages/doc/rate_distortion.md): A Quick Description Of Rate Distortion Theory. (2093 bytes)
- [Tablegen.Txt](pages/doc/tablegen.md): Writing a table generator (2823 bytes)
- [Transforms](pages/doc/transforms.md): The basis transforms used for FFT and various other derived functions are based on the following unrollings. The functions can be easily adapted to double precision floats as well. (31382 bytes)
- [Bootstrap](pages/doc/writing_filters.md): This document is a tutorial/initiation for writing simple filters in libavfilter. (16242 bytes)
